newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch call money rates in balance under 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch call money rates in balance under 3.00 pct.

text.p: Dutch call money rates dropped to a normal level of just under 3.00 percent on Tuesday.
On Monday Call money unexpectedly jumped to a level above 4.00 percent as several market players were balancing their books at the end of the first half of the year.
Dealers said call money was likely to stabilise near the level of the special advances rate, currently 2.90 percent, for at least a few more days.
They said that yesterday's rise was only an blip.
Call was bid between 2.94-3.00 percent in afternoon trade after occasionally being bid as high as 4.5 percent yesterday.
Other rates were stable on Tuesday with three-month deposits bid at an unchanged 3.12 percent.
The guilder remained at 112.55 per 100 marks.
